newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Carter Holt buys Australian plastics firm.
newsitem.headline: Carter Holt buys Australian plastics firm.

text.p: New Zealand forester Carter Holt Harvey said on Monday it had acquired the Australian-based plastics business Associated Plastics Industries (API).
Carter said it plans to grow API by expanding the company's product range through existing capacity.
"Carter Holt Harvey Packaging has had considerable success within the New Zealand industry and is the largest player in the rigid plastics market," Carter Holt said in a statement.
"The acquisition of API will enable us to build from our existing base."

Carter Holt said it had already identified a series of opportunities to expand API's product range. It said it also plans to use API as a platform to gain additional new business in the strategically important food processing area.

"By targeting certain food processors and manufacturers in markets we already supply in New Zealand, for example ice cream, yoghurt, margarine and fast foods, we anticipate significant growth in revenues from new Australian customers," Carter Holt said.
"API will form an excellent base for the expansion of our plastics business in Australia and is an important step in building a trans-Tasman packaging business."
Carter Holt is just over half owned by International Paper.
